claim: Gros and Devanbu build a dataset of Minimal Intent Aligning Patches (MIAP) and compare white-box probing with black-box reflective (verbalized) and self-consistency estimators for token-, line-, and completion-level edit probability.
stance_target: L4/L2: localized calibrated confidence on code is occupied by this work
scope_conditions: GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct generations on HumanEval+, LiveCodeBench, MBPP+, RepoCod-s (Tables 1-2)
quoted_support: We compare white-box probing (where we propose a technique for efficient arbitrary-span querying), against black-box reflective and self-consistency based approaches.
